name: Audio, Haptics, and Fidelity Verification
objectives: Connect production-capable audio and mobile haptic adapters to the existing provider-neutral boundaries
Keep no-op providers available for Editor, unsupported devices, and automated tests
Verify approved-screen composition at 16:9, 18:9, 19.5:9, and 20:9 portrait aspect ratios
Measure gameplay and meta UI allocations and frame pacing on representative Android hardware
Resolve only presentation, clipping, scale-drift, and provider integration defects discovered by verification
Preserve approved artwork, board rules, balance, routes, economy, rewards, story, and save schema
boundary: Provider integration and fidelity verification only: no redesign, new gameplay, economy change, route change, story change, balance change, or save-schema change.
